subject: general
question: Which of the quadratic equations below will not have real roots?
solution:
**Concept used:**

The quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 has no real roots only when discriminant D Option 1:

x2 + 4x + 4 = 0

D = b2 - 4ac 

⇒ D = 4² - 4 × 1 × 4 

⇒ D = 16 - 16 = 0

Option 2:

x2 + 4x + 5 = 0

D = b2 - 4ac 2 - 4 × 1 × 5 

⇒ D = 16 - 20 = -4

Option 3:

x2 + 4x - 4 = 0

D = b2 - 4ac 2 - 4 × 1 × (-4)

⇒ D = 16 + 16 = 32

Option 4:

x2 + 4x - 5 = 0

D = b2 - 4ac 2 - 4 × 1 × (-5)

⇒ D = 16 + 20 = 36

**According to the solution, we can see only Options 2 will not have real roots.**
